degreeType.title: Degree Type
degreeType.description: Optional: MS or MBA. Set it only when the student explicitly asks for an MS or an MBA; otherwise leave it blank so both are considered.

keywords.title: Interest Keywords
keywords.description: Optional. Two or three subject areas or career goals in the student's words, e.g. investment banking, analytics, finance, AI, marketing, consulting. Leave blank to get every program.

needsF1.title: Needs F-1 Visa
needsF1.description: Optional: true if the student needs an F-1 student visa. Excludes online and part-time programs.

onlineOnly.title: Online Only
onlineOnly.description: Optional: true if the student wants to study online.

stemOnly.title: STEM Only
stemOnly.description: Optional: true to return only STEM-designated programs.
